name: gb_status
description: What Greenbox is showing now: open 3D tab, loaded model, rig step, joints, vehicle parts, play test / mocap state.

name: gb_screenshot
description: Picture of the 3D view of a Greenbox page (default: the open one). Use it to check your work.

page.description: create | vehicle | playtest | mocap | retarget (default: current)

name: gb_open
description: Open a Greenbox 3D tab. Tabs stay alive, so work in other tabs is kept.

name: gb_click
description: Click a button/element in a Greenbox page (CSS selector, or visible text with "text=...").

name: gb_set_value
description: Set an input/select value in a Greenbox page and fire its change event.

name: gb_run_js
description: Run JavaScript inside a Greenbox page (async function body; `return` a JSON value). Globals: create page `__gb3d` (Mesh2Motion engine: load_model_step, edit_skeleton_step, easy_rig, weight_skin_step, animations_listing_step, quick_export_all(fmt)), vehicle `__vehicle` (wheels, mechs, new_mech(kind), build_rig(), clips, play(i)), playtest `__playtest` (ctrl), mocap `__mocap`. THREE objects are live.

name: gb_rig_auto
description: On the "Use your model" tab: scan the loaded model and place every joint of the human skeleton (load the human skeleton first if needed).

name: gb_joints_get
description: World positions of every joint on the "Use your model" tab (editing step).

name: gb_joints_set
description: Move joints to world positions {name: [x,y,z]} on the "Use your model" tab (children follow unless listed).

name: gb_rig_finish
description: On "Use your model": compute skin weights and go to the animation list (178 animations).

name: gb_export
description: Export from a Greenbox page: create = rigged model + all animations, vehicle = vehicle rig, mocap = clip. Returns the file (base64) to the caller, which can save it.

name: gb_load_file
description: Load a 3D model / video file into a Greenbox page. `data_b64` is the file content (the MCP server fills it from a path on disk).

name: gb_analyze
description: Analyse the model loaded on a page: what it is (humanoid / quadruped / vehicle / object) and its anchor points — head, arms, legs and accessories (tail, wings, ears, horns, hair, cape, held items) with joint positions inside the mesh. On "vehicle" it can also create a bone chain on every branch (make_bones).

make_bones.description: vehicle page: create free bones along every branch (default true)

name: gb_smash
description: SMASH DOWN blockout (a shooting ad: a wall of cans / boxes on a table, a gun in the middle). Actions: status (ammo, knocked, blocks, layout), preset {name: wall | pyramid | towers | checker | random}, reset (rebuild the stack), shoot {x, y} (0..1 of the 9:16 view), auto {on} (auto shoot), record (start recording the 9:16 view), stop (stop and save the blockout video), prompt (the Seedance video-to-video prompt for the chosen theme). base {name: table | pedestal | steps | float | spin (turntable) | slide (moves side to side), speed? 0–3, color? "#rrggbb"} (what the stack stands on). hit {mode: knock | break} (a hit knocks pieces over, or breaks them into bits), build_base {shape?: box | round, thick? m (0.02–0.8), width? ×(0.5–2.2), depth? ×(0.5–4), legs?: pole | two | four | solid | none} (your own base).

name: gb_vehicle
description: Vehicles / any-model rig tab. Actions: auto_rig (one click: what was learned from 4–5 ★ rigs of the same shape + shape scan + bones + all keyframed animations), rate {score 1–5} (rate the rig on screen; 4–5 ★ rigs teach the next auto_rig), scan_wheels, find_tracks (caterpillar belts as bone chains), add_bone {name, at:[x,y,z], parent?, axis?} (a free bone with its joint at a point; parent chains it), assign_box {part, min:[x,y,z], max:[x,y,z]} (give every vertex inside a box to a part / bone), separate {part} (cut the part into its own mesh and fill the holes), set_type {type: car|truck|tracked|roller}, build (rig + animations), play {clip}, stop, list.

name: gb_map
description: Play-test map editor (terrain + objects, RTS-style). Actions: preset {preset: flat|hills|island|valley|mountains}, add {object: pine|tree|bush|rock|house|tower|wall|fence|crate|barrel|flag, x, z, rot?, scale?}, sculpt {tool: raise|lower|flatten|smooth|paint, x, z, radius?, strength?, ground?: 0 grass 1 dirt 2 sand 3 rock 4 snow 5 road 6 water bed}, water {level}, export_blender (Python script that rebuilds the map in Blender), export_glb, get (map JSON summary). Also: dig {x, z, radius?, depth?} carves a flat-bottomed hole; pour {x, z, fill?: 0.3..1} fills the hole / channel at (x, z) with water up to its rim; sea {on: bool}; erase {x, z, radius?} removes props there; shot_add {mode?: fixed|look|follow, follow?: "player"|object name, t?, dur?, fov?} saves the current camera view as a shot; shots (list); shots_play; layout {image_b64, legend?: [{color:"#rrggbb", kind}]} builds the map from a top-down colour plan (kinds: background grass water sand road dirt mountain snow forest tree house tower wall fence rock flag); export_unity (C# script that plays the shots); plan {plan: {shapes: [{id, kind: zone|block|source|machine|stack|counter|unlock|player, form: rect|ellipse, x, z, w, d, r, label, color, height, gives?, takes?, time?, price?, model?}], wires: [{id, from, to, mode: carry|belt|unlock}]}, play?: bool} builds a 2D plan as a 3D playable (and plays it); clear (empty map).

name: gb_hpbar
description: HP-bar / HUD video layer (its own page, exported separately: green MP4 for Keylight or alpha .MOV). Actions: get, set {settings: partial state, e.g. {hero:{name,level}, hp:{max,start}, mp:{on,max}, dur, fps, size:"1080x1920", bg:"green"|"black"|"clear"}}, events {events:[{t: seconds, kind: dmg|heal|set|mana-|mana+, v: amount}]} (replaces the list: when the hero is hit), export_mov, export_mp4. Boss bar: set {settings:{boss:{on:true, name, max, start, layers, w, h, x, y}}} and events with who:"boss". Hero bar size: hp:{w, h, round, drain, hold}, hud:{flip, on, x, y}. Countdown: page {page:"count"} then set {settings:{cd:{from, to, start, format: s|mmss|dec|dec2, size, x, y, color, stroke, sw, ring, end, endHold, warn}}} and export like the HP bar.

name: gb_drive
description: Driving overlay (Lái xe → Vô lăng & bàn đạp): a steering wheel + 2 pedals that follow a driving video, no hands. Actions: layout (a picture of the wheel / pedals / dash / speedo layout + their positions: SHOW IT TO THE USER and agree the changes first), set_layout {items, confirmed: true} (only after the user said OK), status, load {video_b64, name} (MCP: {path}), auto (the AI reads the video: the scenery sliding sideways = steering, how fast the picture changes = gas / brake; makes the take), export {mode: "video" = the gameplay video with the wheel + pedals on it (finished MP4), "green" = green screen, "black"}.

items.description: set_layout: [{id: dash|pad|wheel|brake|gas|gear|speedo, x?, y?, size?, w?, rot?, hidden?}] in frame pixels

confirmed.description: set_layout: true only after the user saw the layout picture and said OK to these changes

name: gb_sfx
description: SFX sync (Post → Gắn SFX): put sounds on the hits of a finished video. Actions: status (sounds in the library, cues found, clips placed), load {video_b64, name} (MCP: {path}), analyze (finds the hits / cue points), add_all {sound: name or part of it, e.g. "coin"} (that sound on EVERY cue, aligned by its loudest point; repeat with other sounds), export (renders the MP4 with sound). Built-in sounds: Impact boom, Rock crunch, Coin ding, Sparkle shimmer, Whoosh, Upgrade rise, Water splash; the user can add their own in the page.
